prompt:
Create ONE original finished background painting for a fourth room of a whimsical early-1990s point-and-click adventure. Reference 1, the purple McGill lab, is the STYLE AUTHORITY: match its chunky goofy hand-inked cel cartoon, thick dark-plum contours, large simplified props, deliberately wonky perspective, lilac/teal structure, warm custard highlights and orange wood. References 2 and 3 are REAL ARCHITECTURE INSPIRATION ONLY: Lightspeed's Castle/Gare Viger office, with exposed red brick, enormous timber roof trusses and a repeating arched corridor. Translate those physical ideas into the SAME ARTIST'S CARTOON as reference 1, never photographic or finely rendered. This is an imagined iOS POINT-OF-SALE SOFTWARE TESTING OFFICE borrowing old railway-hotel architecture. NO people, characters, game UI, labels, logos, captions, readable words or watermarks. Exactly 3:2 landscape, 1536x1024, edge to edge.

COMPOSITION FOR PLAY: the lower 34 percent is broad clear warm apricot/lilac wooden FLOOR, uncluttered between x38%-85%, y68%-98%, for an adult caricature occupying about half the scene height. An imposing red-brick rear wall, leaning timber columns and HUGE angular exposed wooden roof braces occupy the upper half. A ridiculous broad roof beam spans the image diagonally overhead. Simplify brick into big grouped shapes, not fine texture. At RIGHT x84%-99%, y19%-69%, a tall crooked arched doorway with thick desaturated TEAL trim opens to a softly lit passage with two diminishing arches; it is a clear room exit. No outdoor skyline or landmarks. At back middle x48%-76%, y34%-60%, a small period software developer's desk with an aluminum desktop monitor, blue screen of simple abstract rectangles, modest plant and tilted office chair. Do not fill the room with tiny desks.

The main LEFT FOREGROUND x2%-43%, y38%-71% is a squat teal-painted POS TESTING COUNTER with a warm golden wood top. Counter is large and close enough that individual objects are readable. On its top, an unmistakable early-2010s iPad with thick black bezel and silver back in a tilted chunky cream stand, around x10%-25%, y33%-51%; its display has only THREE BIG ABSTRACT coloured square product tiles and a pale total bar, NO lettering or numerals. To its RIGHT, x31%-41%, y43%-53%, a small chunky cream THERMAL RECEIPT PRINTER, black horizontal paper slot and small teal indicator. NO PAPER emerging from the printer yet: the app adds the receipt. Under the counter a conspicuous CLOSED SHALLOW DRAWER, front facing almost straight toward viewer, spanning x9%-31%, y58%-66%, teal face and large brass handle, narrow dark seam around its latch. Its shape must be simple enough to overlay an open drawer sprite later. A thick cable droops neatly at the counter side, a coffee mug, ONE coffee cup prop, a few large folders on a rear shelf. Keep the surface beneath the printer clear for a separate small receipt paper overlay. No visible retaining clip or guitar pick; those are later separate items.

Strong original adventure-game staging, slightly lopsided and funny rather than a literal reconstruction of an office photograph. Bold plum shadows, warm brick orange, ochre timber, teal joinery, plum/lilac ambient light, simple cel-colour planes. Maintain the established universe's cheerful slightly spooky crooked proportions. No 3D, airbrush, photo texture, pixel dithering, fine line noise or modern polished vector mascot. The room must read as the same game as reference 1 while the exposed timber and brick immediately distinguish it from the cubicle farm. Output ONLY the opaque room background.
